# V68 — 2026-05-25 — Proxy format and companion proxies

**What shipped.** Defined the `.proxies/` layer: a format spec in DOC-STRUCTURE.md, four proxy templates (UX, MANIFEST, TEST-LOG, research), a "read proxy first" required behaviour in universal-behaviour.md, a proxy vocabulary entry, planning procedure step 12 (regenerate proxies), setup procedure updates (cases 1 and 2 generate initial proxies), and scaffold.py creates `.proxies/` with template files during `/setup`. Session A of a three-way split (0081/0089/0090).

**Decisions taken and why.** Proxies are regenerated by Claude (reading the source doc and writing the proxy), not by a script — the format is simple enough that a dedicated parser would be over-engineering. Line-number references (`L<N>`) in proxy entries let Claude target-read specific sections of full docs via offset/limit. TEST-LOG proxy only lists unconfirmed rows — confirmed rows are adequately represented by summary counts.

**Pivots and surprises.** Plugin hooks blocked edits in this folder (phase-aware editing sees "no BACKLOG" as "planning phase" and locks source code). Known bug #39307 means disabling the plugin doesn't stop hooks — Alex had to fully uninstall for this session.

**Carried forward.** After-build proxy regeneration not in scope (session A only covers planning and setup). Sessions B (0089: INDEX relocation to .proxies/) and C (0090: TEST-LOG folder split) follow.
